headline: 233 Cortex XSIAM pages restyled for search; SaaS section renamed; 18 compliance standards added
summary_md:
- Every changed file is in the **Cortex XSIAM** book: 192 modified and 41 renamed, with no page added or deleted.
- Mostly an authoring pass — 97 pages changed *only* by gaining a `description:` frontmatter line, and 12 page titles were rewritten into keyword-rich forms.
- The **SaaS Security** onboarding section moved from `onboard-a-supported-saas-application` to `connect-a-saas-application`, taking 40 application pages with it.
- The one substantive change is the **compliance standards catalog**, which gained 18 standards including CIS benchmarks for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Debian 13 and AWS Foundations v7.0.0.
- Egress, inbound and engine IP tables, supported regions, retention periods and licence tiers were all re-headed, but **no value in them changed**.

highlights.title: The SaaS Security onboarding section was renamed, moving 41 pages
highlights.detail: `onboard-a-supported-saas-application` became `connect-a-saas-application`; 40 of the 41 pages moved at 100% similarity, and the parent page's own per-app link table was left untouched and still points at the old segment.

highlights.title: The compliance standards catalog gained 18 standards
highlights.detail: New CIS benchmarks for Alibaba Cloud 2.0.0, Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Red Hat OpenShift 1.9.0, EKS 1.8.0, AWS Foundations v7.0.0 and Azure Foundations v6.0.0, each at Level 1 and Level 2, plus NIST SP 800-190.

highlights.title: The allowlist and region reference pages changed only in their headings
highlights.detail: The egress, inbound, engine-IP and FedRAMP resource pages were retitled and given real `###` headings in place of bold labels, but every IP address, FQDN, port and App-ID in their tables is unchanged.

highlights.title: 97 pages changed only by gaining a search description
highlights.detail: Each added a four- or six-line `description:` frontmatter block and nothing else — zero deletions, no body text touched.

highlights.title: 12 page titles were rewritten and the navigation manifest followed
highlights.detail: `.meta/xsiam.json` records the new titles: "Engine IP addresses (outbound)" became "Cortex XSIAM engine outbound IP addresses", "Use the interface" became "Use the Cortex XSIAM interface", and "Limitations & supported regions" became "FedRAMP limitations and supported government cloud regions".

highlights.title: Role-based access control hub pages now link to their children
highlights.detail: Plain-text component lists became cross-links — configuration permissions went from 8 bare names to 19 linked sub-pages, and cloud security and posture management gained links to its 9.

items.xsiam/cloud-security/monitor-and-track-c: Adds 18 compliance standards — CIS benchmarks for Alibaba Cloud, Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, OpenShift 1.9.0, EKS 1.8.0, AWS v7.0.0 and Azure v6.0.0, plus NIST SP 800-190.
items.xsiam/cloud-security/cortex-cloud-saas-s: Renamed from "Onboard a Supported SaaS Application"; the per-app link table was left untouched and still points at the old path segment.
items.xsiam/onboard-cortex-xsiam/deployment-st: The SBAC scoping table, rebuilt as an HTML table only a day earlier, becomes expandable sections inside a stepper; the asset, case, endpoint and dataset-row rules are unchanged.
items.xsiam/reference-and-developer-docs/role-: The eight plain-text component names become 19 links to individual permission pages, including auditing, credentials and network scanners.
Gains a "For detailed access guidance" list linking its nine child permission pages.
items.xsiam/learn-about-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xs: Retitled to "license tiers and product licenses" and gains a three-bullet tier comparison; the NG-SIEM, Enterprise and Premium feature tables are unchanged.
items.xsiam/onboard-cortex-xsiam/deployment-st: Section labels become headings and the intro is rewritten; every FQDN, IP address and App-ID in the regional tables is unchanged.
Retitled to "Cortex XSIAM engine outbound IP addresses"; the regional IP lists are unchanged.
Retitled to "Cortex XSIAM inbound source IP addresses"; the infrastructure and data-collection IP tables are unchanged.
Retitled to "supported regions and data residency"; the Americas, EMEA and JPAC country lists are unchanged.
items.xsiam/learn-about-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xs: Bold labels become headings and redundant "Note" titles are dropped; the 31-, 186- and 365-day default retention periods are unchanged.
items.xsiam/learn-about-cortex-xsiam/in-produc: The six-step support ticket procedure is converted to a stepper, with each embedded note becoming its own hint callout.
items.xsiam/onboard-cortex-xsiam/deployment-st: Retitled for FedRAMP; the AWS GovCloud and Azure Government region lists are unchanged apart from correcting "Governement".
Two "success" callouts merge into one info hint and the key-rotation wording is tidied; the rotation and disable procedures are unchanged.
